description: SSL/TLS certificate expiry check for a domain from Certificate Transparency logs (SSLMate Cert Spotter), not a live handshake: the most recent logged unexpired certificate's issuer CA and intermediate, valid from/to dates, days to expiry, expiring-soon flag (under 30 days), revocation status, key type, SANs, wildcard; 90-day issuance history with distinct CAs; plus a live HTTPS reachability check with HSTS and HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect. DNS via Cloudflare DoH. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

domain.description: Hostname to check, e.g. example.com or www.example.com (wildcard certificates covering it are included). Give domain or url.

url.description: Alternative to domain: an http(s) URL whose hostname is checked.

title: SSL/TLS Certificate Check (expiry, issuer, SANs)
